name: Kivotos Mykonos
insider_take: This intimate boutique sanctuary feels like your own private Greek island hideaway, where Cycladic elegance meets sophisticated luxury just steps from Ornos Bay.
whats_special: Kivotos Mykonos is built into a hillside overlooking one of the island's most sheltered bays, featuring traditional whitewashed architecture with modern sophistication. As a Leading Hotels of the World member, it offers exclusivity with only 35 suites and villas, each with private terraces and many with infinity pools. The hotel's location in Ornos provides easy access to the famous beach while maintaining peaceful seclusion from Mykonos Town's bustling nightlife.
pro_tip: Book a suite with a private pool for the ultimate romantic experience - the sunset views from your terrace rival those from the crowded bars in Little Venice, but with complete privacy.
dont_miss: The hotel's Tempura restaurant serves exceptional Mediterranean cuisine with panoramic sea views, while the nearby Ornos Beach offers water sports and beach clubs. Take the complimentary shuttle to explore Mykonos Town's iconic windmills, charming Little Venice waterfront, and designer boutiques along the narrow cobblestone streets.
pros: Intimate boutique property with personalized luxury service
Stunning panoramic views of Ornos Bay and Aegean Sea
Elegant suites and villas with private pools and terraces
Exceptional Mediterranean cuisine at waterfront restaurant
cons: Limited on-site facilities due to boutique size
